subject: Clarify ML tuning exclusion, PII/redaction & logging retention
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@vendmed.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Juan Gomez <juan.gomez@vendmed.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify ML tuning exclusion, PII/redaction & logging retention

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. A couple of compliance items our security team asked me to confirm before we move ahead:

- Will Redwood use any of the data we send (API inputs, logs, attachments) to further train or improve models? We need an explicit opt-out if training is possible.
- What is your default log retention window and can we reduce it (we prefer 30 days or less)?
- Do you redact or provide automatic PII scrubbing? If not, what controls do you recommend?
- Can you promise data residency for our tenant in us-east-1 and that keys are customer-controlled (KMS/HSM)?

If you can send a short write-up we can share with VendMed security. Also, do you have an addendum we can sign to lock in the no-training commitment?

Thanks —
Marta Lopez
Director, Product Security | VendMed

Attachment: — none —
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@vendmed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify ML tuning exclusion, PII/redaction & logging retention

Hi Marta —

Great questions, appreciate the detail. Short answers up front, then a few implementation notes:

1) Training on customer data: NO by default for all paid accounts unless a customer explicitly grants "Model Tuning" permission. For VendMed we will enable a tenant-level opt-out flag and document it in your account profile — your data will not be used to train or fine-tune any Redwood models. This is a contractual commitment we can capture in an addendum.

2) Retention: Default request/response logs are retained for 30 days in hosted plans; we can set your tenant to 30 days as requested. We offer configurable retention (30/90/365) for audit purposes.

3) PII and redaction: We do not perform automatic PII suppression by default. Recommended approach: 1) client-side redaction using our SDK helpers (we can share redaction patterns); 2) server-side automated redaction pipeline (optional) that removes common identifiers before writing logs to persistent storage. See attached redaction-patterns.txt and a short security-summary.pdf with architecture notes.

4) Data residency & keys: We can pin your account to us-east-1. Encryption at rest uses AES-256; we support customer-managed KMS keys (HSM-backed) for private deployments and dedicated customers. For hosted accounts we can enable CMK (customer-managed keys) where allowed — Laura can confirm the legal/controls language.

Next steps (proposed):
- I attached a 1-page security-summary.pdf and the redaction patterns file for your security review.
- I'll circulate a short addendum (no-model-training addendum) that you can sign to make this contractual. Rishi will send for signature and include the DocuSign link.

If VendMed wants us to implement automatic server-side redaction and shorter retention today, we can schedule a quick infra ticket with our DeployOps team and estimate time.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments:
- security-summary.pdf (Architectural overview, SOC2 reference)
- redaction-patterns.txt (common regexes we suggest)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@vendmed.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify ML tuning exclusion, PII/redaction & logging retention

Marta — looping in a short contractual step to lock the no-training commitment.

We have a standard "No Model Tuning" addendum that explicitly states Redwood will not use your inputs, logs, or attachments to train or improve models, including across internal evals, unless you later opt in. For RWI-8421 I have drafted the addendum and included it in the DocuSign envelope linked below so we can get this executed quickly. Signing will also trigger the tenant flag on our side.

DocuSign (addendum): https://docusign.com/ENV-12345-RWI-8421

Operational notes: once signed we will:
- Set retention to 30 days for request/response logs and purge older entries according to your retention policy.
- Enable tenant-level "training_exclusion" so no data leaves your tenant for model tuning.
- Offer optional server-side redaction as an add-on; if you want it now we can scope it.

We're prepared to give a one-time credit if the addendum is executed before your pilot starts; happy to discuss terms.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0147

Attachment: redwood-opt-out-addendum.pdf
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@vendmed.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Juan Gomez <juan.gomez@vendmed.com>, VendMed Security <security@vendmed.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify ML tuning exclusion, PII/redaction & logging retention

All — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. VendMed security reviewed the security-summary.pdf and the redaction patterns; we're comfortable with the proposed tenant flag and 30-day retention.

We will sign the addendum via the DocuSign link today and confirm back once countersigned. Please proceed to mark our tenant for training exclusion once the signed document is received.

One final ask from the compliance team: can you include the exact technical playbook for how the tenant-level flag is enforced (where data is filtered, who can access the toggle, and audit log events for changes)? If you can drop that into the same Drive folder it will help speed our legal review.

Thanks —
Marta

Attachment: VendMed_PO_6789.pdf (will attach countersigned addendum after DocuSign)
